reuse_boundary: Original works are visual references for critique and composition only. Final Pantheon illustration will be original; do not reuse copyrighted illustration fragments as our subject evidence.
preferred_direction: A large asymmetrical Pantheon cutaway becomes the composition; local labels, a light preservation path and a small Colosseum comparison replace stacked sections.
